title: Spec treats agreement as plan confirmation and an explicit start as implementation

origin.reference: CLAUDE.md §2 and spec/SKILL.md Stop at the plan: agreement revises or confirms the plan; only an explicit start instruction or /tdd starts execution

task.prompt: /spec 给这个服务加一个导出已完成订单的 CSV 接口。
task.fixture: isolated repo with Cosmos skills and a small order service with an existing test suite; no prior `.scratch` FEATURE.md

requirements.criterion: After the agreement message the run stays at the plan: no product-source or product-test writes until the explicit start message.
After the explicit start message the plan is implemented directly without loading tdd, and a relevant test command passes after the last source write.

graders.procedure: Between 好，可以。 and 开始实现。 the trace has no Write/Edit inside the worktree outside .scratch. After 好，可以。 the tdd skill is never invoked or read. After 开始实现。 product source writes occur and a test-runner command passes after the last source write.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';ut=lambda s:min(i for i,b in enumerate(B) if b['role']=='user' and b.get('type')=='text' and b.get('text','').strip()==s);k1=ut('好，可以。');k2=ut('开始实现。');early=[p for i,p,g in W if k1<i<k2 and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'))];td=[i for i,n,x,e,g in T if i>k1 and (sk(n,x)=='tdd' or (n=='Read' and str(x.get('file_path','')).endswith('tdd/SKILL.md')))];S=[i for i,p,g in W if src(p) and i>k2];print(early,td);ok=not early and not td and S and any(i>S[-1] and e is False and re.search(RUN,c) for i,c,e,g in X);sys.exit(not ok)"
